input_turns.text: I have a new BOR case.

items.response:
Hi, I’m MTU Assistant. `/help` shows available commands.

Please share:
- existing plan(s) — insurer, plan name, category; or say “none”
- proposed plan — insurer, plan name/riders, category

If there is an existing plan and it’s being replaced, just say so in the same message.
